## Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure:

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines (PEP 8)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have run linting tools (pylint, mypy) and addressed issues

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

### Documentation
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG.md file
- [ ] I have added docstrings to new functions/classes
- [ ] I have updated type hints where applicable

### Git
- [ ] My commits follow the conventional commits format (feat:, fix:, docs:, etc.)
- [ ] I have rebased my branch on the latest main branch
- [ ] I have resolved any merge conflicts
- [ ] My branch has a descriptive name (feature/xxx, fix/xxx, docs/xxx)
